items.title_en: ‘His First Instinct Was To Assault Her’: Knicks Parade Video Shows Revived Fan Trying To Kiss Woman Who Sav
items.title_zh: “他的第一本能就是攻击她”：尼克斯队游行视频显示，复活的球迷试图亲吻那位拯救了她的女人
items.summary_en: A viral video from the Knicks championship parade has sparked outrage after a revived fan repeatedly tried kissing the woman helping save him.
items.summary_zh: 尼克斯队冠军游行的一段视频在网上疯传，一名复活的球迷多次试图亲吻这名女子以拯救他，这引发了愤怒。
